title: Blade to the Heat

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Choose image treatment that carries dramatic energy because viewers form an impression before reading details.
strategic_value: Halftone boxing imagery and diagonal lettering can give this production an immediately forceful character.
demonstration: A boxer fills a yellow poster with red dots; blue title lettering cuts diagonally across the upper body.
practical_value: Compare halftone texture and diagonal type as ways to amplify a production image.

content_islands.name: Boxer and title
content_islands.spec: Overlay the angled title on the large cropped boxer.

content_islands.name: Support labels
content_islands.spec: Place opening information above and credits and the theater signature near the lower corners.
